# Retained judge comparisons

Exported read-only from the OrbStack writer on 2026-09-13 with
`research/judge_acceptance_packet.py`. No third-party request was made.
Every `.body` is the complete archived response, verified against its SHA-256
in `manifest.json`. Source pages and registry lookups were captured on the
dates recorded there; export time is not a new source verification time.

The packet compares three judge names with independently printed entrant IDs
at the same event and with the corresponding registry names. It records
source-supported comparisons, not human adjudications. Judge headers themselves
do not print WSDC IDs. Homonyms and source mistakes remain review questions.

`baseline-summary.json` describes the retained public baseline's judge parquet.
All 4,919 default IDs are null. These examples therefore concern candidates,
not already published judge joins. They cannot demonstrate removal of a false
published judge ID.
